ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram, the species that are the most predatory are what type of consumer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In this food web figure, the bottom consists of several producers labeled “Producer”; above them are several “Primary consumer”, further above are “Secondary consumer”, and at the very top there is a box labeled “Tertiary consumer”. The arrows overall point from producers to primary consumers and secondary consumers, and finally to the tertiary consumer at the top. Reasoning: The question asks which type of consumer the most predatory species belongs to. In a food web, the higher up it is, the higher the trophic level and the stronger the predation; the topmost box is clearly labeled “Tertiary consumer”. Therefore, the most predatory species is a tertiary consumer.
